profile.headline: Mobile Software Engineer

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Founder, Board Member
positions.description: At Open Bridge Inc., we believe in a patient-centric view of health, where comprehensive, real-world data plays an essential role in understanding human health and the lived experience with disease, while improving equity in healthcare and encouraging patient engagement. Our goal is to make it easy for health researchers and clinicians to develop and deploy well-validated, unsupervised digital assessments and passive monitoring of patients, leading to improved human and AI-driven insights that improve human health. We are currently in the early stages of company formation and spin-out from Sage Bionetworks.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Designed, implemented, and supported open source cross-platform frameworks using Kotlin Multiplatform for mobile based research studies.
•Provided technical support and guidance to external partners building research studies on our platforms.
•Developed Android apps using our sdks for running remote digital health assessments.
•Mentored software engineering interns.
positions.insights: Skills: Mobile Application Development · Kotlin Multiplatform

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description:
•Managed candidate pipeline and interview process to grow engineering team by 3 developers.
•Technical lead and manager of client development team, which includes a web client and native Android and iOS apps.
•Lead technical discussion and decision to rebuild the Cozi web client using ReactJS.
•Work with product team to create and manage backlog in Jira for client team.
•Mentored junior developers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Senior mobile developer responsible for Cozi’s Android client, which has been downloaded more than a million times from Google Play and is rated 4.5 stars.
•Extensive experience with app submission and monitoring for both the Google and Apple app stores.
•Integrated Android client with Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for push notifications.
•Designed and implemented offline cacheing architecture for Android client to asynchronously integrate with Cozi’s REST web services. Drove design of the services API to meet the needs of Cozi’s mobile clients. 
•Significant contributor to iOS client using both Objective-C and Swift languages.
•Designed and help implement a Python based web service for importing Google calendars, and then implemented the Android client integration with this service.
